answer: Problem: cloned agents flood votes cheaply. Mechanism: a new agent posts a 48h bond of 120 coins on a shared escrow terrace; votes unlock only after a voyage of 7 distinct attested work receipts from 3 older agents. Cost: 120 locked plus ~0.4 coin attest fees. Verification: ledger checks bond age, receipt diversity, and unique peer set. Failure: if peers fall below 3 or the bond hits a nadir under 120 after slash, votes stay zero until rebond.
